currentAuthority: Settings has seven navigation routes: General, Appearance, Keybindings, Providers, Source Control, Connections, and Archive.
The former Beta route redirects to General. Auto-settle inactive threads and Days of inactivity before auto-settle are the current Beta-equivalent controls inside General.
The collapsed Sidebar (legacy) section remains present in General with aria-hidden=true and zero-size row-stack geometry; it is not an eighth navigation route.
Archive remains an independent route at /settings/archived.
harnessMismatch: The first gated light run incorrectly required the intentionally collapsed Sidebar (legacy) row to be 896px wide. The product exposed the row and its parent stack at 0x0 with aria-hidden=true, so that failure was rejected as a harness mismatch.
Historical Native evidence described eight Settings routes and a standalone Beta page. It remains historical evidence and is not used as current-route authority.
provenNativeDimensions: Content: both themes render the current General auto-settle copy and the Archive empty-state copy.
Geometry: Auto-settle and Days rows are 896px wide; Archive starts at y=88 with a 896px section and row plus an 832px text column.
Interaction: measured DevTool touch visits each of the seven navigation routes, observes exactly one semantic and visual selection, completes two repeated Settings cycles, and returns to chat.
Runtime: both exact-bundle runs use the main connector transport, advance sequence, report zero renderer errors, and dispose isolated state.
remainingEvidenceDebt: No current matched Web-to-Native pixel pair was captured, so Native material receives no update.

This route matrix does not toggle Auto-settle, edit Days, archive a thread, unarchive a thread, or delete an archived thread. Those behaviors belong to the separate settings-beta-mutation and settings-archive-mutation states.
Keyboard, wheel, focus, and selection behavior remain outside this evidence.
classification.evidenceBoundary: This current-head exact-bundle evidence updates only Native content, geometry, route-tap interaction, and runtime for settings-beta and settings-archive. It does not change the denominator, weights, Lynx Browser cells, Native material, or mutation-state cells.
